title: Relay
summary: A bespoke line-based TCP spool service (no scanner signature) plus an HTTP management console. Fingerprint the protocol, recover service creds from a leaked client, exploit a FETCH path traversal to read the console's admin password, then log in for the custody vault.

loot.description: the custom protocol banner (fingerprint target — no scanner match)
RELAY service credentials, leaked by the unauthenticated client download
management console admin password, read via the FETCH path traversal
the custody vault records behind the console's /admin
